hint.ingame: Drag to place the 4 text elements. The font auto-fits the box width - size each box to the maximum space its text should occupy.
hint.idle: Background-only screen shown between teams (when "reveal on Enter/click" is off). Add a title and/or subtitle.
hint.frames: Place and size the timer, score and team-name frame images, and the bonus plate. They are placed independently of the text, so you can enlarge a plate without changing the size of the text inside it.
hint.gauge: Drag the blue handles to align the coloured fill inside your own gauge artwork.
hint.underlay: Drag the blue handle (bottom-right) to size the coloured sub-frame, and the amber handle (top-left) to size the image itself. The round handles (sub-frame bottom-left, image top-right) move them. The two are independent.

ingameLayout.autoFitNote: The text size is set automatically to fill the box: it grows to fill the width and shrinks if it would overflow. Make the box as wide as the space you want the text to occupy at most.
ingameLayout.teamNameHint: Preview only - paste a long name to check the team-name box still reads.
ingameLayout.idleTickHint: Tick to show an element on the idle screen, then drag it on the background.
ingameLayout.elementHidden: {{element}} is hidden. Tick it above to place and style it.
ingameLayout.subtitleHint: Preview only - the real subtitle is typed in the Launch Game window. The title shows the scenario name.
ingameLayout.framesHint: A frame and its text are placed separately. Set the frame here, then the text on the “Texts” tab.
ingameLayout.gaugeHelp: Where the coloured fill starts and stops inside your own gauge artwork. Drag the blue handles on the gauge, or type the values. Insets are % of the gauge, radius is in pixels. The level icons and the player icon follow the same values.
ingameLayout.gaugeDemoHint: Preview only - it changes nothing in the scenario.
ingameLayout.underlayHelp: The centre enigma image and the coloured sub-frame behind it are sized separately, each as a % of the square available to them: make the frame bigger than the image to surround it, or smaller to sit inside it. Each frame's round handle moves it; X and Y shift it from the centre (negative = left / up).
ingameLayout.underlayNote: The preview always draws the sub-frame so you can see it; on the postes de jeu it stays invisible until the enigma has a result. Leave blank to go back to the original size (100 %) - a blank image size follows the sub-frame.
